records.needling: 淺刺 0.1 寸，或點刺出血。

records.location_en: On the ulnar side of the hand, proximal to the head of the 5th metacarpal bone, at the end of the proximal transverse crease when the hand is loosely clenched.
functions_en: Benefits the occiput, neck and back, clears wind and heat. Shu-stream point and confluent point of the Governing Vessel.
indications_en: Pain of the fingers and elbow
